changes.oldText: In this status, you can restore the folder by clicking the restore button on the folder's row in the Name column. If you want to permanently delete the folder, please click the trash bin button on the same row. Once permanent deletion has actually started, the folder can no longer be restored or deleted again: both buttons on its row become unavailable and report "Deletion has already started for this folder."
changes.newText: In this status, you can restore the folder by clicking the restore button on the folder's row in the Name column. If you want to permanently delete the folder, please click the trash bin button on the same row. Once permanent deletion has actually started, the folder can no longer be restored or deleted again: both buttons on its row become unavailable and report "Deletion has already started for this folder." The permanent-delete button is also unavailable for folders you do not have delete permission on, in which case it reports "No delete permission".
